map.→ 打开磁罗经校正工具: -> Open the magnetic compass correction tool
map.基于五系数自差模型，在真航向、磁航向、罗航向间相互换算，并生成各罗经航向的自差值: Based on the five-coefficient deviation model, converts between true, magnetic and compass headings and generates a deviation table for each compass heading, for magnetic compass correction and heading error correction on vessels.
map.海图作业或 GPS 偏置比对时，将罗经读数修正为真北基准，消除罗经差（Dev+V: When charting or comparing against a GPS offset, correct the compass reading to the true north datum, removing the heading deviation introduced by deviation and variation.
map.磁差 Var 是地磁北与真北的夹角（随海区与年变），自差 Dev 是船体磁材对罗: Variation Var is the angle between magnetic north and true north (varies by sea area and year), while deviation Dev is the interference of the hull's magnetic material with the compass (varies with heading); compass error = Dev + Var, the total deviation of the compass reading from true north. At sea just look up the deviation table by heading and correct.
map.磁差和自差有什么区别？: What is the difference between variation and deviation?
map.罗经自检或新装罗经后，用五系数法（A/B/C/D/E）绘制自差表，量化各罗经向位: For compass self-check or after fitting a new compass, use the five-coefficient method (A/B/C/D/E) to plot a deviation table quantifying the deviation correction for each compass heading.
map.罗航向求真航向示例: Example: compass heading to true heading
map.自差 Dev = A + B·sin(CH) + C·cos(CH) + D·s: Deviation Dev = A + B·sin(CH) + C·cos(CH) + D·sin(2CH) + E·cos(2CH), with the coefficients fitted from measured compass headings. Each compass heading CH in the table corresponds to one correction; at sea look it up by the current heading and add or subtract to get the magnetic heading, then add variation for the true heading.
map.自差表（五系数）怎么用？: How do you use the deviation table (five coefficients)?
map.航行推算时，在罗航向(CH)、磁航向(MH)、真航向(TH)之间按磁差(Var): During navigation, convert between compass heading (CH), magnetic heading (MH) and true heading (TH) using variation (Var) and deviation (Dev), meeting navigation planning and collision avoidance needs.
map.：某海区磁差 Var = 5°E、自差 Dev = 3°E，罗航向 CH = 0: : in a certain sea area, variation Var = 5°E and deviation Dev = 3°E; with compass heading CH = 090° find the true heading. Compass error = Dev + Var = 3 + 5 = 8°E; magnetic heading MH = 090 + 3 = 093°; true heading TH = 093 + 5 = 098°. In reverse (true→compass) subtract the corrections in turn: CH = TH − Var − Dev.
